(async function () {
    const checks = [];
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
    const check = (condition, label) => { if (!condition) throw Error(label); checks.push(label); };
    const until = async (predicate) => { const end = Date.now() + 8000; while (!predicate()) { if (Date.now() > end) throw Error("Timed out waiting: " + predicate); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20)); } };
    const pointer = (target, type, props = {}) => target.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 4, clientX: 350, clientY: 350, button: 0, ...props }));
    await until(() => $("project-nav").querySelector("button") && $("kpis").children.length === 4);
    check(!$("view-dashboard").hidden, "dashboard bootstrap");
    $("project-nav").querySelector("button").click();
    await until(() => $("p-graph").querySelectorAll(".gcard").length === 2 && $("p-graph").querySelector(".gcmd"));
    check(!$("view-project").hidden, "project navigation and graph rendering");
    let canvas = $("p-graph").querySelector(".graph-canvas");
    const firstCard = canvas.querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s1"]');
    const command = canvas.querySelector(".gcmd");
    check(canvas.querySelectorAll("path.edge").length === 1, "graph links rendered");
    const beforeZoom = canvas.style.transform;
    $("p-graph").dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent("wheel", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, deltaY: -120, clientX: 450, clientY: 300 }));
    check(canvas.style.transform !== beforeZoom && canvas.style.transform.includes("1.2"), "wheel zoom");
    const panX = parseFloat(canvas.style.left), panY = parseFloat(canvas.style.top);
    pointer($("p-graph"), "pointerdown", { button: 1 });
    pointer(window, "pointermove", { clientX: 390, clientY: 380 });
    check(Math.abs(parseFloat(canvas.style.left) - panX - 40) < .001 && Math.abs(parseFloat(canvas.style.top) - panY - 30) < .001, "middle drag pan");
    pointer(window, "pointercancel");
    const canceledX = canvas.style.left;
    pointer(window, "pointermove", { clientX: 500, clientY: 450 });
    check(canvas.style.left === canceledX && !$("p-graph").classList.contains("panning"), "canceled pan removes gesture listeners");
    pointer(firstCard, "pointerdown"); pointer(window, "pointerup");
    pointer(command, "pointerdown", { ctrlKey: true }); pointer(window, "pointerup");
    check(firstCard.classList.contains("selected") && command.classList.contains("selected"), "mixed session and command selection");
    const firstX = parseFloat(firstCard.style.left), commandX = parseFloat(command.style.left);
    pointer(firstCard, "pointerdown"); pointer(window, "pointermove", { clientX: 398 });
    check(parseFloat(firstCard.style.left) > firstX && parseFloat(command.style.left) > commandX, "selected group drag");
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("blur"));
    check(parseFloat(firstCard.style.left) === firstX && parseFloat(command.style.left) === commandX, "blur restores canceled group positions");
    pointer(firstCard, "pointerdown"); pointer(window, "pointermove", { clientX: 390 });
    await fetch("/fixture/emit", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ type: "sessions" }) });
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
    check($("p-graph").querySelector(".graph-canvas") === canvas, "live redraw defers during gesture");
    pointer(window, "pointerup");
    await until(() => $("p-graph").querySelector(".graph-canvas") !== canvas);
    check(true, "live redraw resumes after gesture");
    $("p-tabs").querySelector('[data-tab="sessions"]').click();
    check(!document.querySelector('[data-panel="sessions"]').hidden && $("p-sessions").querySelectorAll("tbody tr").length === 2, "project sessions tab");
    $("p-tabs").querySelector('[data-tab="git"]').click();
    await until(() => $("g-graph").querySelector(".git-graph-row"));
    check($("g-branch").textContent === "main", "git panel controller and view");
    $("g-tab-history").click();
    check(!$("g-history").hidden, "git history tab");
    $("open-settings").click();
    await until(() => $("settings-dialog").open);
    check($("project-list").children.length === 1, "settings view");
    $("settings-dialog").close();
    $("open-setup").click();
    await until(() => $("setup-dialog").open && $("setup-list").children.length === 2);
    check($("setup-list").textContent.includes("실행 확인 실패") && $("setup-list").textContent.includes("C:/fixture/codex.cmd") && !$("setup-list").textContent.includes("로그인됨"), "CLI execution failure shows its selected path without healthy login status");
    const setupCard = (label) => [...$("setup-list").children].find((item) => item.querySelector("b")?.textContent === label);
    const manualDetails = (item) => [...item.querySelectorAll("details")].find((details) => details.querySelector("summary")?.textContent === "수동 설치");
    const wingetCard = () => setupCard("Windows 패키지 관리자 (winget)");
    check(wingetCard() && !wingetCard().textContent.includes("로그인"), "winget has its own setup card without login actions");
    check([...wingetCard().querySelectorAll("button")].some((button) => button.textContent === "설치·복구"), "winget offers automatic installation and repair");
    const codexManual = manualDetails(setupCard("Codex"));
    check(codexManual.open && codexManual.textContent.includes("자동 설치에 실패했습니다"), "failed automatic installation expands manual recovery instructions");
    check(codexManual.textContent.includes("상단의 ‘다시 확인’"), "manual installation explains how to refresh CLI detection");
    for (const [card, expectedUrl] of [[wingetCard(), "https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/package-manager/winget/"], [setupCard("Codex"), "https://developers.openai.com/codex/cli/"]]) {
      const manual = manualDetails(card), link = manual.querySelector("a");
      check(link.href === expectedUrl && link.target === "_blank" && link.rel.includes("noopener"), "manual installation keeps its official link in a safe new tab: " + expectedUrl);
      check([...manual.querySelectorAll("button")].some((button) => button.textContent === "명령 복사") && manual.querySelector("pre").textContent.length > 0, "manual installation includes a command and copy button: " + card.querySelector("b").textContent);
    }
    [...wingetCard().querySelectorAll("button")].find((button) => button.textContent === "설치·복구").click();
    await until(() => wingetCard().querySelector(".setup-job.running"));
    check([...wingetCard().querySelectorAll("button")].find((button) => button.textContent === "설치·복구").disabled, "winget fixture installation disables repeated starts");
    [...wingetCard().querySelectorAll("button")].find((button) => button.textContent === "취소").click();
    await until(() => wingetCard().querySelector(".setup-job.canceled"));
    check(true, "winget cancellation updates its job through the setup event stream");
    $("setup-refresh").click();
    check($("setup-refresh").disabled, "CLI recheck prevents duplicate requests");
    await until(() => !$("setup-refresh").disabled);
    check(true, "CLI recheck completes and restores its button");
    $("setup-dialog").close();
    $("session-list").querySelector("button").click();
    await until(() => !$("view-session").hidden && $("s-title").textContent === "First");
    check($("s-events").querySelector(".md")?.textContent.includes("Hello"), "session conversation rendering");
    $("s-diff").click();
    await until(() => $("diff-dialog").open);
    check($("diff-status").textContent.includes("fixture.txt") && $("diff-body").textContent.includes("fixture change"), "session diff loads through controller");
    $("diff-dialog").close();
    $("s-prompt").value = "keep my draft";
    const promptNode = $("s-prompt");
    await fetch("/fixture/emit", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ type: "event", payload: { sessionId: "s1", event: { seq: 1, kind: "text", text: "live fragment" } } }) });
    await until(() => $("s-events").textContent.includes("live fragment"));
    check($("s-prompt") === promptNode && promptNode.value === "keep my draft", "stream append preserves composer draft and node identity");
    await fetch("/fixture/emit", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ type: "state", payload: { sessionId: "s1", state: "running", runningStartedAt: new Date().toISOString() } }) });
    await until(() => $("s-state").textContent === "실행 중");
    check($("s-events").classList.contains("running") && !$("s-elapsed").hidden, "live execution state updates list and detail");
    window.dispatchEvent(new PageTransitionEvent("pagehide", { persisted: true }));
    await fetch("/fixture/emit", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ type: "event", payload: { sessionId: "s1", event: { seq: 2, kind: "text", text: "after back-forward cache" } } }) });
    await until(() => $("s-events").textContent.includes("after back-forward cache"));
    check(true, "back-forward cache preserves live updates");
    $("s-prompt").value = "";
    $("s-prompt").dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    check($("s-send").textContent.includes("일시중지"), "composer tracks live running state");
    $("nav-dashboard").click(); $("nav-chat").click();
    check(!$("view-chat").hidden && $("c-title").textContent === "새 채팅", "new chat navigation");
    $("open-new-top").click();
    await until(() => $("new-dialog").open);
    check(!$("new-isolate").checked && $("new-worktree-name").disabled, "new session defaults to original workspace");
    $("new-isolate").checked = true; $("new-isolate").dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
    check($("new-worktree-name").required && !$("new-worktree-name").disabled, "explicit worktree selection");
    $("new-agent").value = "codex-chat"; $("new-agent").dispatchEvent(new Event("change"));
    check(!$("new-isolate").checked && !$("new-worktree-name").required, "chat mode clears workspace selection");
    $("new-dialog").close();

    $("project-nav").querySelector("button").click();
    await until(() => $("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s2"]') && $("p-graph").querySelector(".gcmd"));
    const removable = $("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s2"]');
    const retained = $("p-graph").querySelector(".gcmd");
    pointer(removable, "pointerdown"); pointer(window, "pointerup");
    pointer(retained, "pointerdown", { ctrlKey: true }); pointer(window, "pointerup");
    const savedConfirm = window.confirm, savedAlert = window.alert;
    let confirmations = 0, deletionError = "";
    window.confirm = () => { confirmations++; return true; };
    window.alert = (text) => { deletionError = text; };
    const editor = document.createElement("input"); $("p-graph").append(editor);
    editor.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Delete", bubbles: true }));
    $("p-graph").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Delete", bubbles: true, repeat: true }));
    $("new-dialog").showModal();
    $("p-graph").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Delete", bubbles: true }));
    check(confirmations === 0, "Delete ignores editors repeated keys and open dialogs");
    $("new-dialog").close(); editor.remove();
    $("p-graph").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Delete", bubbles: true }));
    await until(() => deletionError.includes("locked"));
    check(confirmations === 1 && !$("p-graph").querySelector('.gcard[data-id="s2"]'), "Delete removes the selected fixture session with one confirmation");
    check($("p-graph").querySelector(".gcmd").classList.contains("selected"), "failed command deletion retains selection");
    window.confirm = savedConfirm; window.alert = savedAlert;
    $("p-tabs").querySelector('[data-tab="flow"]').click();

    return checks;
  })()
